messages:
marcus: Heads-up — noticed a p99 tail increase after yesterday's kernel-selection tweak (deploy at ~08:30). smallwrites + host-parse CPU up. anyone else seeing this?

talia: saw it in dashboards. topologically it's host-side -- parse + tokenization time increased ~12% on p95, p99 worse.

anya: confirmed on canary traces. flamegraph shows a big chunk in `host_preparse::deserialize` and `grpc::writev_small_writes`

marcus: here's a quick perf snippet from the canary box (spammed with 1k small requests):
```
  25.3% host_preparse::tokenize
  18.7% grpc::writev_small_writes
  12.1% http2::hpack_decode
  8.9% kernel_selector::choose_slow_path
  4.6% kvcache::evict_scan
```

anya: interesting — kernel_selector routed more medium-length seqs to the slow SIMD kernel after the tweak. that increases host-preparse time because we do more copy/normalize steps upstream.

marcus: also noticed socket small-write count went up ~3x, so writev coalescing matters. nginx->envoy fanout looks noisier too.

infra-bot: Deploy 1759009000 finished: kernel-selector v2 rolled to 40% at 08:29 UTC.

talia: quick mitigation idea: make kernel-selector use a fast-path hint for seq_len < 512 when request has prefix cache hit. avoids slow SIMD. low-risk canary?

anya: agree. also add a host-side coalesce layer: buffer small frames for 1-2ms or up to 8KB before writev. trade latency but reduces syscalls. microbench suggests 30% reduction in write syscalls.

marcus: can we also reduce copies in preparse by reusing scratch buffers (mmap ring) instead of repeated allocations? I sketched a patch that uses an arena per-request-thread.

talia: please post perf before/after for arena patch. if we get p99 down on canary, we can roll.

anya: posted a quick canary run results: p99 latency dropped ~9% after kernel hint + writev coalesce + arena reuse (combined). raw numbers: p95 -6%, p99 -9%. small improvement but consistent. link: https://perf.internal/reports/1759012345

marcus: nice. action items: 1) I will open PR to add kernel-selector hint for prefix-cache cases 2) talia will add a small writev coalesce flag behind a runtime knob 3) anya will extend canary test to 24h and add kvcache eviction telemetry.

anya: FYI there's a potential KV-cache thrash pattern when coalescing delays cause larger batches to hit eviction heuristics. I'll watch that during the 24h canary.

sre-oncall: ping me if p99 regresses >10% or error-rate spikes. i'll hold rollback playbook ready.

marcus: thanks — deploying the hint PR to canary now. will update thread with links to PR and flamegraphs. :thumbsup:
